notes.title: Steam Inventory Items Added! Daily Reward System Changed To Local Time!
notes.content:
Steam Inventory Items Added:
I've added steam inventory items, right now they are just for trading. A random item drops on the main menu every 15mins, menu must be reloaded to trigger the drop system.

Daily Reward System Changed To Local Time:
I've changed the daily reward system to use local system.datetime to avoid any liability issues with the server time web api I was using. The game now checks your systems date & time to reward daily bonuses.

You can always use the "IMLAZY" cheat by typing it in on the main menu to skip the grind!

notes.title: Circuit Cheat Fixed
notes.content: 1. At request I have added 2 checkpoints to the AI circuit race to fix from cheating the time. Thank you <redacted> player for messaging me about the issue.

notes.title: Breakpoint Crash Fix / Level Editor Edge Panning
notes.content:
1. Removed code causing possible breakpoint exceptions that would then possibly crash the game for the player.
2. Added code for edge panning in level editor (this fixes a bug for some users that stops them from panning the camera using mouse input)

notes.title: Custom Level Bug Fix
notes.content:
1. Fixed bug with penalty carrying over to custom levels when starting
2. Fixed bug with reset car when falling of the map

notes.title: Money Cheat
notes.content:
By request, I've added a cheat for money since unlocks take too dang long.
Type "imlazy" on the main menu to unlock 100k credits. You must type it within 10 seconds of pressing the first letter.

notes.title: Bad Resolution Bug Fix v2
notes.content:
So... As I've said before.... I never fix a bug "right" the first time. This time if your game is broken it should detect it and reset it. This is due to some bug using the smallest resolution with the unity standalone player.

Its... A stupid, simple fix but those are usually the best. If you are using the smallest resolution it will force the game menu to load full screen resolution every time the menu is loaded. This assures the bug is fixed, even while playing.

notes.title: Smallest Resolution Bug Fix
notes.content:
*smacks head* idk what caused this but when you used the smallest resolution it would break the game.
My sincerest of apology, this update will fix it if it has broken for you.

I think it was a class communication error (or some **** like that in the resolution/screen mode settings.

notes.title: Daily Rewards Server Time
notes.content: Moved daily rewards to a server time, sorry if this effects your rewards at all. Better sooner than later.

notes.title: Sponsorship Bonuses Fixed | Daily Login Reward Fixed
notes.content:
I had a great review letting me know these issues existed. I knocked them out. (Allegedly) there are still issues getting to 4th gear or above? Please let me know if you have any issues!

1. Sponsorships fixed: you will now get rewards from sponsors
2. Daily rewards fixed: you will now get credit rewards from daily logins

I never do anything right the first time :)
